badges.title: User badges
badges.description: Badges identify roles, milestones, and contributions on this imshare instance.

admin.name: Admin
admin.description: Identifies an account with administrator privileges.
admin.howToEarn: Automatically shown while the account has the admin role.

moderator.name: Moderator
moderator.description: Identifies an account with moderation privileges.
moderator.howToEarn: Automatically shown while the account has the moderator role.

veteran.name: Veteran
veteran.description: Marks an account that has been active for at least one year.
veteran.howToEarn: Automatically awarded after the account reaches one year of age.

contributor.name: Contributor
contributor.description: Recognizes meaningful contributions to the project or community.

verified.name: Verified
verified.description: Marks an account that has been verified by the instance.

early-adopter.name: Early Adopter
early-adopter.description: Recognizes people who joined during the early stage of the instance.

bug-hunter.name: Bug Hunter
bug-hunter.description: Recognizes people who help identify and report bugs.

supporter.name: Supporter
supporter.description: Recognizes people who support the project or community.

founder.name: Founder
founder.description: Recognizes a person who founded or established the instance or project.

developer.name: Developer
developer.description: Recognizes people who contribute code or technical development.

community-helper.name: Community Helper
community-helper.description: Recognizes people who regularly help other members.

curator.name: Curator
curator.description: Recognizes people who help organize, classify, or curate content.
